title.narrative: Rapidly march towards new HIV infection elimination, maintain progress made, and advance towards Ending HIV/AIDS as a public health threat goal; and accelerate finding and successfully treating of missing TB cases(DS-TB&DR-TB)for Ending TB - Cambodia (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Cambodia, TB/HIV, Cambodia Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF)This program has the following goals: Ending AIDS as a public health threat in Cambodia by 2025. To reduce TB incidence by 80% and TB deaths by 90% in 2030 compared with 2015, in line with SDG and End TB Strategy.. The objectives of this program are: Avert new infections to less than 250 by 2025 through tailored and customized prevention interventions. Intensify targeted case detection to achieve the 1st 95.. Uphold the 2nd 95 to ensure the 3rd 95 through universal coverage of quality HIV-related services along the HIV cascade of care. Sustain a robust national response through integration and securing domestic fiscal space for HIV. To Find and treat all Tuberculosis cases. To Address the programme specific needs and priorities (Community DOTS/Community TB Care, Private Sector involvement, MDR TB, TB/HIV, TB DM, and TB in prisons. To provide TB Preventive Therapy (TPT) to eligible population. To strengthen NTP monitoring and evaluation system
